title: The first deliverable that decides for you
description:
Dave switched on his first agent last night and it sent eleven emails before he went to bed. Rabi starts with the thirty seconds every owner says at the door when they leave someone in charge, and why nobody is saying it to AI agents. What AEBOK is, in plain words. Why an AI agent is the first tool a business has bought that takes over part of the deciding. And the rule for the series: nothing gets switched on without its line.

Readiness quiz: https://autonomousenterpriseai.com/readiness-quiz
Owners' group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/HeLeFUhqdbYKYxou4n723i

Planned and drafted with Anthropic Claude, extensively edited. Rabi's voice is his authorised synthetic voice. Dave is an invented character voiced by AI. Shop and Save is a fictional business.
